title: Allow changing password
line: Vaults that use EncFS or gocryptfs now have a Password tab in their Configure dialog for changing the vault's password.
explanation: Plasma Vault had no way to change a vault's password: the backends only passed the password when creating or unlocking a vault, so the only option was to create a new vault and move the files. gocryptfs (-passwd) and EncFS (encfsctl autopasswd) can change it themselves; CryFS cannot. The change adds a changePassword operation to the vault engine for those two backends and a Password tab to the Configure dialog (current password, new password with confirmation, and a notice that the data is not re-encrypted). Pressing OK changes the password first; if that fails (for example a wrong current password) the error is shown and the dialog stays open.

commits.message:
kded: Allow changing the password of EncFS and gocryptfs vaults

There was no way to change a vault's password other than recreating it.
Add a Password tab to the vault configuration dialog for the backends
that support it, with a notice that the data itself is not re-encrypted.

BUG: 445841

media.caption: Configure dialog of a gocryptfs vault on master: General, Advanced and Delete only, no way to change the password
With the fix: a Password tab with a notice about re-encryption, the current password and the new password
A wrong current password is reported and the dialog stays open
OK stays disabled until the current password is entered (EncFS vault)
